title: Impersonation banner adds its height to a full-height shell: list footers and bulk action bars fall below the viewport
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · sunhaolin · session_local1adc6fb3954245ba8940a3719cdaea98

Filing gate: ① product defect with a reproduction. Source: fleet (found in a maintainer-ordered local UI test pass of the HotCRM app on 2026-11-26; filed through the pm-dispatch relay on the maintainer's instruction).
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · severity: Impeded · reach: every administrator while impersonating, on every full-height page · evidence: measured on the released 18.6.0 packages (2026-11-18), zh-CN console; not re-measured on main

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：模拟用户时顶部横幅要算进页面高度，不能把整页往下挤出屏幕。
- 谁受益：用「模拟用户」排查权限问题的管理员。
- 不做会怎样：模拟期间列表底部的批量操作栏和记录数被挤到屏幕外，整页多出一条滚动条。
- 需要你做的：无，分诊定级即可。

## What

While an impersonation is active the console shows a banner above the shell. The shell below it still takes the full viewport height, so the document becomes taller than the window by the banner's height.

Measured: `window.innerHeight` 768, document `scrollHeight` 821. On a list view the bulk action bar and the record-count footer sit below the fold, and the page gains a second, outer scrollbar.

## Reproduction

1. As an administrator, start impersonating any user from the users list.
2. Open any list view and tick a row.
3. Result: the bulk action bar and the footer are not visible until the whole page is scrolled; without impersonation the same page fits the viewport exactly.

## Acceptance

- With the banner shown, the document's `scrollHeight` equals `innerHeight` on full-height pages; the shell takes the viewport height minus the banner.
- List footers, bulk action bars and sticky dialog footers stay visible during an impersonation.
- Holds on the mobile layout.

Dedupe (open and closed): `impersonation banner`, `impersonation banner height` 0 hits about layout.
Batch-of: local UI deep test pass 2026-11-26, 14 cards (5 in hotcrm, 9 in objectstack).
Blocked-by: none.
